method: Locked Style Bible pins + approved per-style visual-review records + technical MP4 probe of the three publishable reference films. Subjective impression alone is insufficient.

checklist_results.notes: Each film uses its locked Style Bible package (editorial, scientific-notebook, paper-cinema) with approved visual-review records.
Locked 1800-frame / 60 s Scene IR workloads B-01/B-02/B-03; shot structure pinned by golden manifests and review records.
Shot boundaries and continuity covered by per-style visual-review checklists (shot_boundaries / shot_continuity / reference_frames).
1080×1920 canvas; typography/safe_area/phone_legibility items approved in visual-review records; quality-release policy requires those checklist ids.
Scene provenance style_packages match catalog style_package ids/versions and Style Bible fixtures.
Technical probe requires 1080×1920, nominal 30 fps, one video track, zero audio tracks, ~60 s duration.

notes: This signoff is the creative gate for publishable reference films, not a certified performance measurement.
MP4 digests are filled into catalog-v1.json after a verified export; checker rejects null digests when --require-files is set.
